topics.title: Cleveland Funeral Plans
topics.summary: During a radio broadcast, hosts discuss logistics for attending a funeral in Cleveland involving a former baseball player who died in an accident and was subsequently caned in Malaysia. They debate the feasibility of staging a mock execution with dummies on a dock while also scheduling a meeting with the host’s wife to confirm availability.

topics.title: Bra Shopping and Political Speeches
topics.summary: During the show, Howard discusses his mother’s annual bra purchase while revisiting recordings from a political convention. He critiques Elephant Boy's overly formal nominating speech as ‘I hear by,’ repeatedly mishearing it, and then re-listens to Kenneth Keith Callenback’s bizarre pronouncements alongside commentary on the event.

topics.title: Stern Attacks Congressman Moran on Free Time
topics.summary: Howard Stern criticizes Representative Jim Moran for allegedly spending excessive time focusing on Stern’s activities instead of addressing national issues like healthcare and crime, calling him a ‘coward.’ He urges listeners to pressure the congressman during his upcoming reelection.

topics.title: Representative Moran Urges Voters to Vote Against Him
topics.summary: During a radio broadcast, Representative Jim Moran asks listeners who haven't voted before to consider voting against him in the upcoming election. He directs them to vote for the Republican candidate and encourages an investigation into his activities, culminating in calls to target him like Howard Stern.

topics.title: Nixon’s Sweating Box Revelation
topics.summary: During a CBS broadcast, hosts discussed former President Nixon and his reported sweating during ceremonies involving a box. Guests speculated on G. Gordon Liddy and Ed Nixon's reactions while referencing a potential movie titled ‘Weekend at Nixon’s,’ featuring Sylvester Stallone, and attempts to load the body into a ramp with difficulty.

topics.title: Stern vs. Congress Oversight
topics.summary: Congressman Jim Moran advocated for increased fines against Infinity Broadcasting’s Howard Stern show, citing concerns about its content following a debate over FCC oversight. topics.title: Pat Cooper Rants About Smoked Milk and Spy Cows
topics.summary: During a lengthy broadcast, Pat Cooper expresses outrage over milk from hormone-injected cows, criticizes regulations, and delves into conspiracy theories involving government spying through livestock. He discusses Joan Rivers’ Broadway play and makes unsupported claims about the health effects of secondhand smoke.

topics.title: Quayle Discusses Presidential Dissatisfaction and OTB
topics.summary: Former Vice President Dan Quayle expresses his dissatisfaction with the presidency, stating it lacks thrill and suggesting a death penalty as an alternative. He then proposes returning horse racing to prominence through Off-Track Betting operations, criticizing the Bush administration’s campaign run.

topics.title: Horse Meat, Family Feuds & Celebrity Gossip
topics.summary: A man recounts eating horse meat during wartime and discusses a shooting involving his son after an alcohol problem. The conversation shifts to celebrity gossip including reviews of Pat Cooper's performances and bizarre obsession with Michael Jackson’s habits, alongside discussions about television ratings and upcoming events.
